WITH actor_allowed AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM t_user actor JOIN t_user_role user_role ON user_role.user_id = actor.id JOIN t_role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.role_id = user_role.role_id JOIN t_permission permission ON permission.id = role_permission.permission_id WHERE actor.id = #{actorUserId} AND actor.status = 1 AND actor.deleted_at IS NULL AND permission.code = 'domain:update' ) AS allowed ), target AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT id FROM t_domain WHERE id = #{domainId} ), updated AS ( UPDATE t_domain SET name = #{name,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{domainId} AND (SELECT allowed FROM actor_allowed) AND name IS DISTINCT FROM #{name,jdbcType=VARCHAR} RETURNING id ) SELECT CASE WHEN NOT (SELECT allowed FROM actor_allowed) THEN 0 WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN 1 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM updated) THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
